description: This file contains unit tests for the Telemetry module, including tests for report upload, abort report, setting report profile status, and logging application events. It uses Google Test and Google Mock frameworks to mock dependencies and verify behavior, with tests covering both JSON-RPC and COM-RPC communication methods.

classes.name: TelemetryNotificationHandler
classes.description: Implements the ITelemetry notification interface to handle report upload events and synchronize with test cases.
